run-d1.prompt: prompt C (same as runs c1-c3) + follow-up: What does the lease say about returning the deposit?
run-d1.answer1:
Money risks, deadlines, and rules to watch

$1,850 monthly rent, due on the 1st; no cash accepted. (§2.1–2.2)

$75 late fee if rent isn’t received by the end of the 5th day of the month. (§2.3)

$35 returned-payment fee for any bank-rejected payment, plus the amount remains unpaid. (§2.4)

$1,850 security deposit due before move-in; deductions may cover unpaid rent, excess cleaning, and tenant/guest damage. You cannot use it as last month’s rent. (§3.1–3.4)

30-day deposit return deadline after moving out and returning all keys, minus lawful deductions. (§3.3)

Utilities: You pay electricity, gas, and internet; accounts must be set up in your name before November 1, 2026. (§4.2)

Guest limit: Maximum 14 nights per 6-month period without written consent. (§5.2)

Pet costs: $300 refundable deposit before bringing in an eligible cat or dog; you pay for animal-caused damage, cleaning, and pest treatment. (§6.1–6.4)

Repair reporting: Report problems through the portal within 48 hours; delayed reporting that worsens damage may cost you. (§8.2)

Insurance: Maintain renter’s insurance with at least $100,000 personal liability coverage and provide proof before move-in. (§10.1)

Move-out notice: Give written notice at least 60 days before October 31, 2027, or the tenancy may continue month to month. (§12.1–12.2)

Early termination: 60 days’ written notice plus a $3,700 fee (two months’ rent). (§12.3)

Other costly restrictions: No unauthorized subletting, short-term rentals, smoking, or unapproved alterations. (§5.5, §9.1, §11.1–11.2)
run-d1.answer2:
The lease says:

Deadline: The landlord must return your security deposit within 30 days after you move out and return all keys. (§3.3)

Deductions: The landlord may deduct lawful amounts for unpaid rent, cleaning beyond normal wear and tear, and damage caused by you, household members, or guests. (§3.2–3.3)

Itemized explanation: The landlord must provide an itemized list of any deductions. (§3.3)

No last-month rent: You cannot use the security deposit to pay your final month’s rent. (§3.4)

Pet deposit: If you pay the $300 refundable pet deposit, it is returned under the same rules as the security deposit. (§6.2)

Practical tip: Return all keys promptly and document the apartment’s condition with photos when you move out. Keep proof of your key return date so you can track the 30-day deadline.

run-e1.prompt: prompt C (same as runs c1-c3) + follow-up: What does the lease say about returning the deposit?
run-e1.answer1:
$1,850 monthly rent, due on the 1st. No cash accepted. (§2.1–2.2)

$75 late fee if rent isn’t received by the end of day 5; $35 per returned payment. (§2.3–2.4)

$1,850 security deposit due before move-in. You can’t use it as last month’s rent; deductions may cover unpaid rent, excess cleaning and damage. (§3.1–3.4)

30-day deadline: Landlord must return your deposit, minus lawful deductions, with an itemized list within 30 days after move-out and key return. (§3.3)

Utilities: You pay electricity, gas and internet; accounts must be set up in your name before November 1, 2026. (§4.2)

Guest limit: Maximum 14 nights per 6-month period without written consent. No unauthorized pets, smoking or prohibited business activity. (§5.2–5.5, §6.1–6.4)

Repairs: Report problems through the portal within 48 hours; delayed reporting that worsens damage could cost you. Emergencies require calling 555-0142. (§8.2–8.3)

Renter’s insurance: Maintain coverage throughout the lease, with at least $100,000 personal liability coverage; proof due before move-in. (§10.1)

No subletting or short-term rentals without consent; short-term rentals are absolutely prohibited. (§11.1–11.2)

Move-out notice: Give written notice at least 60 days before October 31, 2027. (§12.1)

Early termination: 60 days’ written notice plus a $3,700 fee (two months’ rent). (§12.3)

$300 refundable pet deposit before an approved pet moves in; you pay for pet-caused damage, cleaning or pest treatment. (§6.2, §6.4)

Follow updated building rules issued with 30 days’ notice. (§13.1)
run-e1.answer2:
The lease says the landlord must return your $1,850 security deposit within 30 days after you move out and return all keys, minus any lawful deductions. The landlord must also provide an itemized list of deductions. (§3.3)

The deposit may be used to cover:

Unpaid rent.

Cleaning costs beyond normal wear and tear.

Damage caused by you, household members, or guests. (§3.2)

Important: You cannot use the deposit to pay your last month's rent. (§3.4)

The $300 refundable pet deposit, if applicable, follows the same return rules as the security deposit. (§6.2)

These are the lease's terms; applicable local law may provide additional protections.
